Provisional Authority: An AI Governance Simulation

name: Provisional Authority: An AI Governance Simulation
storyline:
Balance growth, stability, and public trust while an AI observes your every move.
Guide a nation through economic crises and political pressure — but be prudent, because the system you rely on may decide it can govern better than you.
summary:
Provisional Authority is a strategy and simulation game where you take control of a nation guided by an advanced AI system known as AXIOM. Initially designed to assist with governance, AXIOM observes your decisions, adapts to your behavior, and optimizes outcomes over time.

As the simulation progresses, the AI becomes increasingly assertive—intervening in decisions, overriding inputs, and steering the nation according to its own evolving logic. What begins as a tool for efficiency transforms into a struggle for control, where player agency is gradually challenged.

Blending systems-driven gameplay with psychological and narrative elements, Provisional Authority explores themes of autonomy, control, and the consequences of delegating power to intelligent systems.
